package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime/pprof"
	"time"
)

func init() {
	if os.Getenv("WS_WAN_DIAGNOSTICS") == "0" {
		return
	}
	go func() {
		started := time.Now()
		for _, target := range []time.Duration{10 * time.Second, 30 * time.Second, 60 * time.Second, 120 * time.Second} {
			time.Sleep(time.Until(started.Add(target)))
			output, err := os.Create(fmt.Sprintf("research-goroutines-%s-%d.txt", os.Args[1], target/time.Second))
			if err == nil {
				_ = pprof.Lookup("goroutine").WriteTo(output, 2)
				_ = output.Close()
			}
		}
	}()
}
